title: Dynamic Product Gallery for WooCommerce before 3.6.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows…
description: Dynamic Product Gallery for WooCommerce versions before 3.6.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. Authenticated users with Contributor-level access or higher can inject arbitrary JavaScript via the product_id attribute of specific shortcodes. This injected script executes in the browsers of users who view the affected posts, including editors and administrators.
